name: How to make a Pet Henchman

pages.name: How to make a Pet Henchman

text.content:
One day I hope a Henchmen generator like /Char for characters will automate this but unfortaunately I'm not a coder.

 

• Pets are 'Henchmen'.

• Henchmen have full Character Sheets and are given to a Player to play alongside their PC.

• A Player's Henchmen earn half the XP of their PC.

• This XP is spent as normal.

 

As per WFRP Bestiary p. 318 Random Creatures and Custom PC species

To create Pets out of traditionally NPC species such as cats, dogs and horses.

  1. Use random Characteristics
  2. Add an appropriate career

 

Use a full Character sheet

Fill out the details name, species, gender etc.

Take a Breed or Pure Breed from the Bestiaries included in the Compendiums with this module.

  1. In the Notes Tab copy it's Creature Traits from the Notes section to the full character sheet.
  2. If in the Biography it mentions Random Traits roll them and drag those onto the full character sheet too, rerolling duplicates if necessary.
    Either copy the creature sheet into the world and click the link to roll in the chat log.
    or type /Table cat-traits or /Table dog-traits or /Table horse-traits from the chat log.

Use random Characteristics

Copy the Characteristics from the Creature sheet to the character sheet. Making changes as below to randomise them.

To randomly create Characteristics, subtract –10, then add 2d10. So, a Characteristic of 30 translates to 2d10+20.

If a Characteristic starts at 5, roll just 1d10 to randomise it.

0 stays at 0.

 

Add an appropriate career

Open the appropriate cat dog or horse Career Journal from the Compendium and add Career 1 to the full character sheet.

 

XP is accumulated when accompanying the PC

Which equals half the XP of their PC. Spend as usual.

I would assume characters starting with an animal. Their pet would begin with 1/2 the PCs initial XP.
